name: Coiling Palm
description: Wind the arm in a coil and release a palm that carries the turn of the whole body.

name: Coil Step
description: Wind the stride in a rising coil that climbs around the opponent to the high side.

name: Winding Guard
description: Wind a ward in loops about the body that tighten wherever a blow strikes.

name: Spiral Lance
description: Spin a lance of qi in a spiral so it drills through a guard and keeps lengthening.

name: Widening Coil
description: Cast a coil of qi around the target that widens to reach each limb and then draws tight.

name: Twist Rend
description: Wrench a grip with a twisting force that keeps turning past the point of the break.

name: Gyre Mend
description: Turn restoring qi through a wound in a gyre that closes it from the edges inward.

name: Endless Gyre
description: Spin a gyre of force that widens as it turns and flings away all it touches.

name: Spiral Ascent
description: Climb a spiral of steps that never ends and strike downward at each turn of the coil.

name: Helix Pierce
description: Drive a helix of qi through the guard that keeps boring deeper into the wound after contact.

name: Rising Spiral
description: The school's spiral in which the strike winds upward without end and drives home with all the turns at once.

name: Mirrorfist
description: Strike with one fist and watch the other fist throw the same blow into its reflection.

name: Dyad Step
description: Move in paired steps that echo each other and leave a false trail behind.

name: Reflected Ward
description: Set a ward before a ward before a ward so that each is a reflection of the last.

name: Dyad Lance
description: Cast a lance and its reflection side by side and watch both lengthen as one.

name: Mirror Cascade
description: Cascade matched blows in mirrored pairs that double the pressure on the guard.

name: Reciprocal Mend
description: Pass restoring qi back and forth between two wounded allies until both are mended.

name: Unending Dyad
description: Send a pair of surging waves back and forth across the target until their force overwhelms it.

name: Infinite Reflection
description: Face two mirrored guards so a blow is bounced between them and gathers force each time.

name: Boundless Dyad
description: Hit with a pair of blows whose reflections never cease and shake the target to its core.

name: Endless Pair
description: The school's pair in which two tracks reflect each other without end and deal one swelling blow.

name: Horizon Fist
description: Throw a fist aimed at the far edge of vision and let the qi carry it as far as it can.

name: Outreach Stride
description: Take a stride that reaches farther with each breath the wind fills it.

name: Openair Guard
description: Hold a guard open to the air with no front or back and no wall to break.

name: Reach Sense
description: Send attention out along the wind and learn the layout as far as the air will carry it.

name: Beyond Lance
description: Thrust a lance across a gap no weapon should bridge and let it bite at the other end.

name: Skyward Cord
description: Fling a cord of wind upward that comes down around the target from a great height.

name: Windbound Reach
description: Cast a bolt on the wind that keeps going and does not slow or fall.

name: Horizon Mend
description: Send a mending wind across a distance to close the wound of an ally who cannot be reached.

name: Boundless Gust
description: Raise a gust that sweeps past every edge and knocks aside all that stand before it.

name: Skyreach Rush
description: Rush toward the horizon on the wind and strike at every body passed along the way.

name: Edgeless Gale
description: Raise a gale with no edge or limit whose wounding persists in all it has crossed.

name: Open Horizon
description: The school's horizon in which the wind-sworn reach beyond all sight and loose one blow along the whole of it.

name: Vowfast Fist
description: Throw a fist held fast by a vow so it lands with the weight of every blow before it.

name: Vowed Tread
description: Hold a sworn pace through any press so no step is shorter than the last.

name: Unbroken Stance
description: Hold a stance renewed by oath at every breath so it cannot be worn through.

name: Pledge Cascade
description: Pour out a cascade of blows each sworn on the one before it and each heavier than the last.

name: Vow Reservoir
description: Bank every kept vow in a reservoir in the Core and draw on it to lift the strength of an ally.

name: Pledge Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of qi along a sworn line that grows with the length of the vow.

name: Renewing Vow
description: Renew a vow to mend and send fresh qi into the wounds of an ally or the self at each breath.

name: Vow Eternal
description: Strike under a vow with no end and bind the breath of the target to the blow.

name: Everlasting Bearing
description: Take an everlasting bearing under oath so the guard and the user's strength stay without limit.

name: Eternal Vowstrike
description: Strike under an eternal vow whose wound persists as long as the swearer keeps faith.

name: Unending Vow
description: The school's vow that renews itself with each breath and swells into one blow no oath can end.
